Accessibility

Choose settings that make practice easier to use.

KickMaths offers reading and motion preferences for its website and primary maths game. Please tell us if any part prevents a pupil, parent or teacher from using it.

Dyslexia-friendly reading mode.

The labelled setting changes the font, text spacing and reading background. It does not change the answers, rewards or learning evidence.

See the dyslexia-friendly guide

Keyboard, zoom and motion.

  • Use Tab to move between controls and Enter or Space to activate buttons.
  • Use your browser’s zoom controls to enlarge text.
  • Set Reduce motion in the game for fewer animated effects.
  • Use untimed practice when a countdown is unhelpful. Written calculations have extra working time in timed matches.

Report an accessibility problem.

Email enquiries@kickmaths.co.uk or use our feedback form. Tell us which page or game activity you were using, your device and what made it difficult. Please avoid including a child’s personal details.
